start_line.description: Start Line: The line number of the first line of code block identified as vulnerable. (recommended)

cpe_name.description: The product CPE identifier: The Common Platform Enumeration (CPE) name. (optional)

hash.description: Hash: Cryptographic hash to identify the binary instance of a software component. (optional)

license.description: Software License: The software license applied to this package. (optional)

license_url.description: Software License URL: The URL pointing to the license applied on package or software. (optional)

path.description: Path: The installation path of the affected package. (optional)

remediation.description: Remediation Guidance: Describes the recommended remediation steps to address identified issue(s). (optional)

type.description: Type: The category of the analysis target, such as User Account, Kubernetes Cluster, Network Namespace, or Application Component. (optional)

object_analytic.description: The Analytic object contains details about the analytic technique used to analyze and derive insights from the data or information that led to the creation of a finding or conclusion.

algorithm.description: Algorithm: The algorithm used by the underlying analytic to generate the finding. (optional)

desc.description: Description: The description of the analytic that generated the finding. (optional)

name.description: Name: The name of the analytic that generated the finding. (recommended)

related_analytics.description: Related Analytics: Other analytics related to this analytic. (optional)

sensor_info_list.description: Sensor Information List: An array of sensor_info objects, each describing a sensor control point analyzed or correlated by the analytic. (optional)

state_id.description: State ID: The Analytic state identifier. (optional) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Active, 2 = Suppressed, 3 = Experimental, 99 = Other

type.description: Type: The analytic type. (optional)

type_id.description: Type ID: The analytic type ID. (required) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Rule, 10 = Partial Data Match, 11 = Indexed Data Match, 2 = Behavioral, 3 = Statistical, 4 = Learning (ML/DL), 5 = Fingerprinting, 6 = Tagging, 7 = Keyword Match, 8 = Regular Expressions, 9 = Exact Data Match, 99 = Other

uid.description: Unique ID: The unique identifier of the analytic that generated the finding. (recommended)

uid_numeric.description: Numeric Unique ID: The uid attribute in numeric form where applicable.Note: Producers may populate uid_numeric only in addition to uid and not as an alternative to it. (optional)

version.description: Version: The analytic version. (optional)

object_anomaly.description: Describes an anomaly or deviation detected in a system.

observation_parameter.description: Observation Parameter: The specific parameter, metric or property where the anomaly was observed. (required)

observation_type.description: Observation Type: The type of analysis methodology used to detect the anomaly. (recommended)

observations.description: Observations: Details about the observed anomaly or observations that were flagged as anomalous compared to expected baseline behavior. (required)

observed_pattern.description: Observed Pattern: The specific pattern identified within the observation type. (recommended)

object_anomaly_analysis.description: Describes the analysis of activity patterns and anomalies of target entities to identify potential security threats, performance issues, or other deviations from established baselines.

analysis_targets.description: Analysis Targets: The analysis targets define the scope of monitored activities, specifying what entities, systems or processes are analyzed for activity patterns. (required)

anomalies.description: Anomalies: List of detected activities that significantly deviate from the established baselines. (required)

baselines.description: Baselines: List of established patterns representing normal activity that serve as reference points for anomaly detection. (recommended)

object_api.description: The API, or Application Programming Interface, object represents information pertaining to an API request and response.

group.description: Group: The information pertaining to the API group. (optional)

operation.description: Operation: Verb/Operation associated with the request (required)

request.description: API Request Details: Details pertaining to the API request. (recommended)

response.description: API Response Details: Details pertaining to the API response. (recommended)

service.description: Service: The information pertaining to the API service. (optional)

token.description: Token: The API or client token used to authenticate or authorize the API request. (optional)

version.description: Version: The version of the API service. (optional)

object_application.description: An Application describes the details for an inventoried application as reported by an Application Security tool or other Developer-centric tooling.

criticality.description: Business Criticality: The criticality of the application as defined by the event source. (optional)

data.description: Data: Additional data describing the application. (optional)

desc.description: Application Description: A description or commentary for an application, usually retrieved from an upstream system. (optional)

group.description: Group: The name of the related application or associated resource group. (optional)

hostname.description: Hostname: The fully qualified name of the application. (optional)

labels.description: Labels: The list of labels associated to the application. (optional)

name.description: Application Name: The name of the application. (recommended)

owner.description: Owner: The identity of the service or user account that owns the application. (recommended)

product.description: Product: The software product that this application is an instance of, carrying product identity such as vendor_name, cpe_name, and canonical version. (optional)

region.description: Region: The cloud region of the resource. (optional) Needs profile: cloud.

resource_relationship.description: Application Relationship: A graph representation showing how this application relates to and interacts with other entities in the environment. (optional)

risk_level.description: Risk Level: The risk level, normalized to the caption of the risk_level_id value. (optional)

risk_level_id.description: Risk Level ID: The normalized risk level id. (optional) 0 = Info, 1 = Low, 2 = Medium, 3 = High, 4 = Critical, 99 = Other

risk_score.description: Risk Score: The risk score as reported by the event source. (optional)

sbom.description: Related SBOM: The Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) associated with the application (optional)

tags.description: Tags: The list of tags; {key:value} pairs associated to the application. (optional)

type.description: Application Type: The type of application as defined by the event source, e.g., GitHub, Azure Logic App, or Amazon Elastic BeanStalk. (optional)

uid.description: Application ID: The unique identifier for the application. (recommended)

uid_alt.description: Application Alternative ID: An alternative or contextual identifier for the application, such as a configuration, organization, or license UID. (optional)

url.description: URL: The URL of the application. (optional)

version.description: Application Version: The semantic version of the application, e.g., 1.7.4. (optional)

object_assessment.description: The Assessment object describes a point-in-time assessment, check, or evaluation of a specific configuration or signal against an asset, entity, person, or otherwise.

category.description: Category: The category that the assessment is part of. (optional)

desc.description: Description: The description of the assessment criteria, or a description of the specific configuration or signal the assessment is targeting. (recommended)

meets_criteria.description: Meets Criteria: Determines whether the assessment against the specific configuration or signal meets the assessments criteria. (required)

name.description: Name: The name of the configuration or signal being assessed. (recommended)

policy.description: Assessment Policy: The details of any policy associated with an assessment. (optional)

uid.description: Unique ID: The unique identifier of the configuration or signal being assessed. (optional)

uid_numeric.description: Numeric Unique ID: The uid attribute in numeric form where applicable.Note: Producers may populate uid_numeric only in addition to uid and not as an alternative to it. (optional)

object_attack.description: The Attack object describes the tactic, technique, sub-technique & mitigation associated to an attack.

mitigation.description: MITRE Mitigation: The Mitigation object describes the MITRE ATT&CK® or ATLAS™ Mitigation ID and/or name that is associated to an attack. (optional)

sub_technique.description: MITRE Sub-technique: The Sub-technique object describes the MITRE ATT&CK® or ATLAS™ Sub-technique ID and/or name associated to an attack. (recommended)

tactic.description: MITRE Tactic: The Tactic object describes the Tactic ID and/or name associated to an attack. (recommended)

tactics.description: Tactics: The Tactics associated with the attack technique. (optional)

technique.description: MITRE Technique: The Technique object describes the MITRE ATT&CK® or ATLAS™ Technique ID and/or name associated to an attack. (recommended)

version.description: Version: The ATT&CK® or ATLAS™ Matrix version. (recommended)

object_attestation.description: A cryptographic attestation that an event has not been altered since it was produced and was produced by the holder of a verifiable identity, providing integrity, authenticity, and non-repudiation.

authority_uid.description: Authority ID: Unique identifier of the authority that produced this attestation. (recommended)

chain_uid.description: Chain ID: Identifier of the append-only chain, such as a forensic or audit log, that this event belongs to. (recommended)

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint: The fingerprint of this event's canonical serialization. (recommended)

prev_event.description: Previous Event: Reference to the previous event in a tamper-evident chain, carrying that event's fingerprint together with locator attributes for retrieval. (recommended)

signatures.description: Digital Signatures: One or more digital signatures, each computed over this event's fingerprint and thereby over the event's canonical serialization, each bound to a verifiable identity. (recommended)

uid.description: Attestation ID: Unique identifier of this attestation. (optional)

object_auth_factor.description: An Authentication Factor object describes a category of methods used for identity verification in an authentication attempt.

device.description: Device: Device used to complete an authentication request. (recommended)

email_addr.description: Email Address: The email address used in an email-based authentication factor. (optional)

factor_type.description: Factor Type: The type of authentication factor used in an authentication attempt. (recommended)

factor_type_id.description: Factor Type ID: The normalized identifier for the authentication factor. (required) 0 = Unknown, 1 = SMS, 10 = WebAuthn, 11 = Password, 2 = Security Question, 3 = Phone Call, 4 = Biometric, 5 = Push Notification, 6 = Hardware Token, 7 = OTP, 8 = Email, 9 = U2F, 99 = Other

is_hotp.description: HMAC-based One-time Password (HOTP): Whether the authentication factor is an HMAC-based One-time Password (HOTP). (recommended)

is_totp.description: Time-based One-time Password (TOTP): Whether the authentication factor is a Time-based One-time Password (TOTP). (recommended)

phone_number.description: Phone Number: The phone number used for a telephony-based authentication request. (optional)

provider.description: Provider: The name of provider for an authentication factor. (recommended)

security_questions.description: Security Questions: The question(s) provided to user for a question-based authentication factor. (optional)

object_authentication_token.description: The Authentication Token object extends the base token object and represents standardized authentication tokens, tickets, or assertions that conform to established authentication protocols such as Kerberos, OIDC, and SAML.

created_time.description: Created Time: The time that the authentication token was created or issued. (recommended)

created_time_dt.description: Created Time: The time that the authentication token was created or issued. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

encryption_details.description: Encryption Details: The encryption details of the authentication token. (recommended)

expiration_time.description: Expiration Time: The expiration time of the authentication token. (optional)

expiration_time_dt.description: Expiration Time: The expiration time of the authentication token. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

is_renewable.description: Renewable: Indicates whether the authentication token is renewable. (optional)

kerberos_flags.description: Kerberos Flags: A bitmask, either in hexadecimal or decimal form, which encodes various attributes or permissions associated with a Kerberos ticket. (recommended)

modified_time.description: Modified Time: The last time the token was updated. (optional)

modified_time_dt.description: Modified Time: The last time the token was updated. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

name.description: Name: The human-friendly name of a token or key, if available, such as the name from the Okta API Token API. (optional)

tenant_uid.description: Tenant UID: The unique identifier of the tenant or organization that owns the token or key, or the tenant context in which the token is authorized for use. (optional)

type.description: Type: The type of the authentication token. (recommended)

type_id.description: Type ID: The normalized authentication token type identifier. (recommended) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Ticket Granting Ticket, 2 = Service Ticket, 3 = Identity Token, 4 = Refresh Token, 5 = SAML Assertion, 6 = Client Token, 7 = API Token, 99 = Other

uid.description: Unique ID: The unique ID of a token or key, if available, such as the Secret ID of Entra ID Application Registration Client Secrets. (optional)

zone.description: Network Zone: The network zone or geographic region that the token or key is authorized to be used from. (optional)

object_authorization.description: The Authorization Result object provides details about the authorization outcome and associated policies related to activity.

policy.description: Policy: Details about the Identity/Access management policies that are applicable. (optional)

object_autonomous_system.description: An autonomous system (AS) is a collection of connected Internet Protocol (IP) routing prefixes under the control of one or more network operators on behalf of a single administrative entity or domain that presents a common, clearly defined

name.description: Name: Organization name for the Autonomous System. (recommended)

number.description: Number: Unique number that the AS is identified by. (recommended)

object_baseline.description: Describes the baseline or expected behavior of a system, service, or component based on historical observations and measurements.

observation_parameter.description: Observation Parameter: The specific parameter or property being monitored. (required)

observation_type.description: Observation Type: The type of analysis being performed to establish baseline behavior. (recommended)

observations.description: Observations: Collection of actual measured values, data points and observations recorded for this baseline. (required)

observed_pattern.description: Observed Pattern: The specific pattern identified within the observation type. (recommended)

object_campaign.description: Campaign represent organized efforts by threat actors to achieve malicious objectives over a period, often characterized by shared tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).

name.description: Name: The name of a specific campaign associated with a cyber threat. (required)

object_certificate.description: The Digital Certificate, also known as a Public Key Certificate, object contains information about the ownership and usage of a public key.

created_time.description: Created Time: The time when the certificate was created. (recommended)

created_time_dt.description: Created Time: The time when the certificate was created. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

expiration_time.description: Expiration Time: The expiration time of the certificate. (recommended)

expiration_time_dt.description: Expiration Time: The expiration time of the certificate. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

fingerprints.description: Fingerprints: The fingerprint list of the certificate. (recommended)

is_self_signed.description: Certificate Self-Signed: Denotes whether a digital certificate is self-signed or signed by a known certificate authority (CA). (recommended)

issuer.description: Issuer Distinguished Name: The certificate issuer distinguished name. (required)

sans.description: Subject Alternative Names: The list of subject alternative names that are secured by a specific certificate. (optional)

serial_number.description: Certificate Serial Number: The serial number of the certificate used to create the digital signature. (required)

subject.description: Subject Distinguished Name: The certificate subject distinguished name. (recommended)

uid.description: Unique ID: The unique identifier of the certificate. (optional)

version.description: Version: The certificate version. (recommended)

object_check.description: The check object defines a specific, testable compliance verification point that evaluates a target device against a standard, framework, or custom requirement.

desc.description: Description: The detailed description of the compliance check, explaining the security requirement, vulnerability, or configuration being assessed. (optional)

name.description: Name: The name or title of the compliance check. (recommended)

resource.description: Resource: Describes details about the resource that this check evaluated. (optional)

severity.description: Severity: The severity level as defined in the source document. (optional)

severity_id.description: Severity ID: The normalized severity identifier that maps severity levels to standard severity levels. (optional) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Informational, 2 = Low, 3 = Medium, 4 = High, 5 = Critical, 6 = Fatal, 99 = Other

standards.description: Compliance Standards: List: The regulatory or industry standard this check is associated with. (recommended)

status.description: Status: The resultant status of the compliance check normalized to the caption of the status_id value. (recommended)

status_id.description: Status ID: The normalized status identifier of the compliance check. (recommended) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Pass, 2 = Warning, 3 = Fail, 99 = Other

uid.description: Unique ID: The unique identifier of the compliance check within its standard or framework. (recommended)

version.description: Version: The check version. (optional)

object_cis_benchmark.description: The CIS Benchmark object describes best practices for securely configuring IT systems, software, networks, and cloud infrastructure as defined by the Center for Internet Security.

cis_controls.description: CIS Controls: The CIS Critical Security Controls is a prioritized set of actions to protect your organization and data from cyber-attack vectors. (recommended)

desc.description: Description: The CIS Benchmark description. (optional)

name.description: Name: The CIS Benchmark name. (required)

object_cis_benchmark_result.description: The CIS Benchmark Result object contains information as defined by the Center for Internet Security (CIS) benchmark result.

desc.description: Description: The CIS benchmark description. (optional)

name.description: Name: The CIS benchmark name. (required)

remediation.description: Remediation Guidance: Describes the recommended remediation steps to address identified issue(s). (optional)

object_cis_control.description: The CIS Control (aka Critical Security Control) object describes a prioritized set of actions to protect your organization and data from cyber-attack vectors.

desc.description: Description: The CIS Control description. (optional)

name.description: Name: The CIS Control name. (required)

version.description: Version: The CIS Control version. (recommended)

object_cis_csc.description: The CIS Critical Security Control (CSC) contains information as defined by the Center for Internet Security Critical Security Controls (CIS CSC).

control.description: Security Control: A Control is prescriptive, prioritized, and simplified set of best practices that one can use to strengthen their cybersecurity posture. (required)

version.description: Version: The CIS critical security control version. (recommended)

object_classifier_details.description: The Classifier Details object describes details about the classifier used for data classification.

name.description: Name: The name of the classifier. (recommended)

type.description: Type: The type of the classifier. (required)

uid.description: Unique ID: The unique identifier of the classifier. (recommended)

object_clipboard.description: The Clipboard object represents an endpoint clipboard and its contents.

contents.description: Clipboard Contents: The data items written to, or read from, the clipboard. (recommended)

name.description: Name: The name of the clipboard on systems with named clipboards. (optional)

object_clipboard_item.description: A piece of data on the system clipboard.

binary_data.description: Binary Data: The item's data in binary form, used when the clipboard content cannot be represented as text or when preserving the exact binary representation is required. (optional)

clipboard_native_type.description: Data Type: The type of the item's data, in an operating specific form. (optional)

mime_type.description: MIME type: The Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) type of the item's data. (required)

string_data.description: String Data: The item's data if it can be represented as a UTF-8 string. (optional)

object_cloud.description: The Cloud object describes the cloud computing environment where an event or finding originated.

account.description: Account: The Account object containing details about the cloud account, subscription, or billing unit where the event or finding was created. (optional)

cloud_partition.description: Cloud Partition: The logical grouping or isolated segment within a cloud provider's infrastructure where the event or finding was created, often used for compliance, governance, or regional separation.Examples:AWS: Partition where the event occurred (aws, a (optional)

org.description: Organization: The Organization object containing details about the organizational unit or management structure that governs the account, subscription, or project where the event or finding was created. (optional)

project_uid.description: Project ID: The unique identifier of a Cloud project. (optional)

provider.description: Cloud Provider: The unique name of the Cloud services provider where the event or finding was created. (required)

region.description: Region: The cloud region where the event or finding was created, as defined by the cloud provider.Examples:AWS: Region where the event occurred (us-east-1, eu-west-1)Azure: Region where the event occurred (East US, West Europe)GCP: Region where the (recommended)

zone.description: Cloud Availability Zone: The availability zone in the cloud region where the event or finding was created, as defined by the cloud provider.Examples:AWS: Availability zone where the event occurred (us-east-1a, us-east-1b)Azure: Availability zone where the event occ (optional)

object_compliance.description: The Compliance object contains information about Industry and Regulatory Framework standards, controls and requirements or details about custom assessments utilized in a compliance evaluation.

assessments.description: Assessments: A list of assessments associated with the compliance requirements evaluation. (optional)

category.description: Category: The category a control framework pertains to, as reported by the source tool, such as Asset Management or Risk Assessment. (optional)

checks.description: Compliance Checks: A list of compliance checks associated with specific industry standards or frameworks. (optional)

compliance_references.description: Compliance Standard References: A list of reference KB articles that provide information to help organizations understand, interpret, and implement compliance standards. (optional)

compliance_standards.description: Compliance Standards: Details: A list of established guidelines or criteria that define specific requirements an organization must follow. (optional)

control.description: Security Control: A Control is a prescriptive, actionable set of specifications that strengthens device posture. (recommended)

control_parameters.description: Control Parameters: The list of control parameters evaluated in a Compliance check. (optional)

desc.description: Description: The description or criteria of a control. (optional)

requirements.description: Compliance Requirements: The specific compliance requirements being evaluated. (optional)

standards.description: Compliance Standards: List: The regulatory or industry standards being evaluated for compliance. (recommended)

status.description: Status: The resultant status of the compliance check normalized to the caption of the status_id value. (recommended)

status_code.description: Status Code: The resultant status code of the compliance check. (optional)

status_detail.description: Status Detail: The contextual description of the status, status_code values. (optional)

status_details.description: Status Details: A list of contextual descriptions of the status, status_code values. (optional)

status_id.description: Status ID: The normalized status identifier of the compliance check. (recommended) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Pass, 2 = Warning, 3 = Fail, 99 = Other

object_container.description: The Container object describes an instance of a specific container.

hash.description: Hash: Commit hash of image created for docker or the SHA256 hash of the container. (recommended)

image.description: Image: The container image used as a template to run the container. (recommended)

labels.description: Labels: The list of labels associated to the container. (optional)

name.description: Name: The container name. (recommended)

network_driver.description: Network Driver: The network driver used by the container. (optional)

orchestrator.description: Orchestrator: The orchestrator managing the container, such as ECS, EKS, K8s, or OpenShift. (optional)

pod_uuid.description: Pod UUID: The unique identifier of the pod (or equivalent) that the container is executing on. (optional)

runtime.description: Runtime: The backend running the container, such as containerd or cri-o. (optional)

size.description: Size: The size of the container image. (recommended)

tag.description: Image Tag: The tag used by the container. (optional)

tags.description: Tags: The list of tags; {key:value} pairs associated to the container. (optional)

uid.description: Unique ID: The full container unique identifier for this instantiation of the container. (recommended)

object_cpu_info.description: The CPU information object contains attributes describing a physical CPU package installed in the device.

cores.description: Cores: The number of processing cores or compute units for the component. (optional)

cpu_architecture.description: CPU Architecture: The CPU architecture, normalized to the caption of the cpu_architecture_id value. (optional)

cpu_architecture_id.description: CPU Architecture ID: The normalized identifier of the CPU architecture. (optional) 0 = Unknown, 1 = x86, 2 = ARM, 3 = RISC-V, 99 = Other

cpu_bits.description: CPU Bits: The number of bits used by the CPU for memory addressing. (optional)

model.description: Model: The model name of the CPU. (recommended)

speed_mhz.description: Compute Unit Speed (MHz): The nominal clock speed of the unit, expressed in megahertz. (optional)

vendor_name.description: Vendor Name: The name of the vendor of the CPU. (recommended)

object_cve.description: The Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) object represents publicly disclosed cybersecurity vulnerabilities defined in CVE Program catalog (CVE).

created_time.description: Created Time: The Record Creation Date identifies when the CVE ID was issued to a CVE Numbering Authority (CNA) or the CVE Record was published on the CVE List. (recommended)

created_time_dt.description: Created Time: The Record Creation Date identifies when the CVE ID was issued to a CVE Numbering Authority (CNA) or the CVE Record was published on the CVE List. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

cvss.description: CVSS Score: The CVSS object details Common Vulnerability Scoring System scores from the advisory that are related to the vulnerability. (recommended)

cwe.description: CWE: The CWE object represents a weakness in a software system that can be exploited by a threat actor to perform an attack. (optional)

cwe_uid.description: CWE UID: The Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) unique identifier. (optional)

cwe_url.description: CWE URL: Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) definition URL. (optional)

desc.description: Description: A brief description of the CVE Record. (optional)

epss.description: EPSS: The Exploit Prediction Scoring System (EPSS) object describes the estimated probability a vulnerability will be exploited. (optional)

modified_time.description: Modified Time: The Record Modified Date identifies when the CVE record was last updated. (optional)

modified_time_dt.description: Modified Time: The Record Modified Date identifies when the CVE record was last updated. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

product.description: Product: The product where the vulnerability was discovered. (optional)

references.description: References: A list of reference URLs with additional information about the CVE Record. (recommended)

related_cwes.description: Related CWEs: Describes the Common Weakness Enumeration details related to the CVE Record. (optional)

title.description: Title: A title or a brief phrase summarizing the CVE record. (recommended)

type.description: Vulnerability Type: The vulnerability type as classified in the CVE catalog.Most frequently used vulnerability types are: DoS, Code Execution, Overflow, Memory Corruption, Sql Injection, XSS, Directory Traversal, Http Response Splitting, Bypass something, Gain (recommended)

uid.description: CVE ID: The Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures unique number assigned to a specific computer vulnerability. (required)

object_cvss.description: The Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) object provides a way to capture the principal characteristics of a vulnerability and produce a numerical score reflecting its severity.

base_score.description: Base Score: The CVSS base score. (required)

depth.description: CVSS Depth: The CVSS depth represents a depth of the equation used to calculate CVSS score. (recommended) Base = Base, Environmental = Environmental, Temporal = Temporal

metrics.description: Metrics: The Common Vulnerability Scoring System metrics. (optional)

overall_score.description: Overall Score: The CVSS overall score, impacted by base, temporal, and environmental metrics. (recommended)

severity.description: Severity: The Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) Qualitative Severity Rating. (optional)

src_url.description: Source URL: The source URL for the CVSS score. (optional)

vector_string.description: Vector String: The CVSS vector string is a text representation of a set of CVSS metrics. (optional)

vendor_name.description: Vendor Name: The vendor that provided the CVSS score. (recommended)

version.description: Version: The CVSS version. (required)

object_cwe.description: The CWE object represents a weakness in a software system that can be exploited by a threat actor to perform an attack.

caption.description: Caption: The caption assigned to the Common Weakness Enumeration unique identifier. (optional)

src_url.description: Source URL: URL pointing to the CWE Specification. (optional)

uid.description: CWE ID: The Common Weakness Enumeration unique number assigned to a specific weakness. (required)

object_d3f_tactic.description: The Defensive Tactic object describes the tactic ID and/or name that is associated to an attack.

name.description: Name: The tactic name that is associated with the defensive technique. (recommended)

src_url.description: Source URL: The versioned permalink of the defensive tactic. (optional)

uid.description: Unique ID: The unique identifier of the defensive tactic. (recommended)

uid_numeric.description: Numeric Unique ID: The uid attribute in numeric form where applicable.Note: Producers may populate uid_numeric only in addition to uid and not as an alternative to it. (optional)

object_d3f_technique.description: The Defensive Technique object describes the leaf defensive technique ID and/or name associated to a countermeasure.

name.description: Name: The name of the defensive technique. (recommended)

src_url.description: Source URL: The versioned permalink of the defensive technique. (optional)

uid.description: Unique ID: The unique identifier of the defensive technique. (recommended)

uid_numeric.description: Numeric Unique ID: The uid attribute in numeric form where applicable.Note: Producers may populate uid_numeric only in addition to uid and not as an alternative to it. (optional)

object_d3fend.description: The Defensive Countermeasure object describes the tactic & technique associated with a countermeasure.

d3f_tactic.description: MITRE D3FEND™ Tactic: The Tactic object describes the tactic ID and/or name that is associated with a countermeasure. (recommended)

d3f_technique.description: MITRE D3FEND™ Technique: The Technique object describes the technique ID and/or name associated with a countermeasure. (recommended)

version.description: Version: The D3FEND™ Matrix version. (recommended)

object_data_classification.description: The Data Classification object includes information about data classification levels and data category types.

category.description: Category: The name of the data classification category that data matched into, e.g. (optional)

category_id.description: Category ID: The normalized identifier of the data classification category. (recommended) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Personal, 2 = Governmental, 3 = Financial, 4 = Business, 5 = Military and Law Enforcement, 6 = Security, 99 = Other

classifier_details.description: Classifier Details: Describes details about the classifier used for data classification. (recommended)

confidentiality.description: Confidentiality: The file content confidentiality, normalized to the confidentiality_id value. (optional)

confidentiality_id.description: Confidentiality ID: The normalized identifier of the file content confidentiality indicator. (recommended) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Not Confidential, 2 = Confidential, 3 = Secret, 4 = Top Secret, 5 = Private, 6 = Restricted, 99 = Other

discovery_details.description: Discovery Details: Details about the data discovered by classification job. (optional)

policy.description: Policy: Details about the data policy that governs data handling and security measures related to classification. (optional)

size.description: Size: Size of the data classified. (optional)

src_url.description: Source URL: The source URL pointing towards the full classification job details. (optional)

status.description: Status: The resultant status of the classification job normalized to the caption of the status_id value. (recommended)

status_details.description: Status Details: The contextual description of the status, status_id value. (optional)

status_id.description: Status ID: The normalized status identifier of the classification job. (recommended) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Complete, 2 = Partial, 3 = Fail, 99 = Other

spf.description: SPF Status: The Sender Policy Framework (SPF) status of the email. (recommended)

zone.description: Network Zone: The network zone or LAN segment. (optional)

object_endpoint_connection.description: The Endpoint Connection object contains information detailing a connection attempt to an endpoint.

network_endpoint.description: Network Endpoint: Provides characteristics of the network endpoint. (recommended)

object_enrichment.description: The Enrichment object provides inline enrichment data for specific attributes of interest within an event.

created_time_dt.description: Created Time: The time when the enrichment data was generated. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

reputation.description: Reputation Scores: The reputation of the enrichment data. (optional)

short_desc.description: Short Description: A short description of the enrichment data. (recommended)

object_epss.description: The Exploit Prediction Scoring System (EPSS) object describes the estimated probability a vulnerability will be exploited.

version.description: Version: The version of the EPSS model used to calculate the score. (recommended)

object_evidences.description: A collection of evidence artifacts associated to the activity/activities that triggered a security detection.

actor.description: Actor: Describes details about the user/role/process that was the source of the activity that triggered the detection. (recommended)

ai_agent.description: AI Agent: Describes details about an AI agent associated with the activity that triggered the detection, whether the agent performed the activity, was its target, or was otherwise involved. (recommended)

container.description: Container: Describes details about the container associated to the activity that triggered the detection. (recommended)

data.description: Data: Additional evidence data that is not accounted for in the specific evidence attributes. (optional)

database.description: Database: Describes details about the database associated to the activity that triggered the detection. (recommended)

databucket.description: Databucket: Describes details about the databucket associated to the activity that triggered the detection. (recommended)

device.description: Device: An addressable device, computer system or host associated to the activity that triggered the detection. (recommended)

dst_endpoint.description: Destination Endpoint: Describes details about the destination of the network activity that triggered the detection. (recommended)

email.description: Email: The email object associated to the activity that triggered the detection. (recommended)

file.description: File: Describes details about the file associated to the activity that triggered the detection. (recommended)

http_request.description: HTTP Request: Describes details about the http request associated to the activity that triggered the detection. (recommended)

http_response.description: HTTP Response: Describes details about the http response associated to the activity that triggered the detection. (recommended)

ja4_fingerprint_list.description: JA4+ Fingerprints: Describes details about the JA4+ fingerprints that triggered the detection. (recommended)

job.description: Job: Describes details about the scheduled job that was associated with the activity that triggered the detection. (recommended)

name.description: Name: The naming convention or type identifier of the evidence associated with the security detection. (optional)

process.description: Process: Describes details about the process associated to the activity that triggered the detection. (recommended)

query.description: DNS Query: Describes details about the DNS query associated to the activity that triggered the detection. (recommended)

resources.description: Cloud Resources: Describes details about the cloud resources directly related to activity that triggered the detection. (recommended)

script.description: Script: Describes details about the script that was associated with the activity that triggered the detection. (recommended)

src_endpoint.description: Source Endpoint: Describes details about the source of the network activity that triggered the detection. (recommended)

tls.description: TLS: Describes details about the Transport Layer Security (TLS) activity that triggered the detection. (recommended)

uid.description: Unique ID: The unique identifier of the evidence associated with the security detection. (optional)

uid_numeric.description: Numeric Unique ID: The uid attribute in numeric form where applicable.Note: Producers may populate uid_numeric only in addition to uid and not as an alternative to it. (optional)

url.description: URL: The URL object that pertains to the event or object associated to the activity that triggered the detection. (recommended)

user.description: User: Describes details about the user that was the target or somehow else associated with the activity that triggered the detection. (recommended)

verdict.description: Verdict: The normalized verdict of the evidence associated with the security detection. (optional)

verdict_id.description: Verdict ID: The normalized verdict (or status) ID of the evidence associated with the security detection. (optional) 0 = Unknown, 1 = False Positive, 10 = Duplicate, 2 = True Positive, 3 = Disregard, 4 = Suspicious, 5 = Benign, 6 = Test, 7 = Insufficient Data, 8 = Security Risk, 9 = Managed Externally, 99 = Other

object_extension.description: The OCSF Schema Extension object provides detailed information about the schema extension used to construct the event.

object_file.description: The File object represents the metadata associated with a file stored in a computer system.

accessed_time_dt.description: Accessed Time: The time when the file was last accessed. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

attributes.description: Attributes: The bitmask value that represents the file attributes. (optional)

confidentiality.description: Confidentiality: The file content confidentiality, normalized to the confidentiality_id value. (optional)

created_time_dt.description: Created Time: The time when the file was created. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

encryption_details.description: Encryption Details: The encryption details of the file. (optional)

ext.description: File Extension: The extension of the file, excluding the leading dot. (recommended)

hashes.description: Hashes: An array of hash attributes. (recommended)

imported_symbols.description: Imported Symbols: A list of symbols imported by the executable file. (optional)

internal_name.description: Internal Name: The name of the file as identified within the file itself. (optional)

is_deleted.description: Deleted: Indicates if the file was deleted from the filesystem. (optional)

is_encrypted.description: Encrypted: Indicates if the file is encrypted. (optional)

is_public.description: Public: Indicates if the file is publicly accessible. (optional) Needs profile: cloud.

is_readonly.description: Read-Only: Indicates that the file cannot be modified. (optional)

is_system.description: System: The indication of whether the object is part of the operating system. (optional)

mime_type.description: MIME type: The Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) type of the file, if applicable. (optional)

object_http_request.description: The HTTP Request object represents the attributes of a request made to a web server.

args.description: HTTP Arguments: The arguments sent along with the HTTP request. (optional)

body_length.description: Request Body Length: The actual length of the HTTP request body, in number of bytes, independent of a potentially existing Content-Length header. (optional)

http_headers.description: HTTP Headers: Additional HTTP headers of an HTTP request or response. (recommended)

http_method.description: HTTP Method: The HTTP request method indicates the desired action to be performed for a given resource. (recommended) ACL = ACL, BASELINE-CONTROL = Baseline Control, BIND = Bind, CHECKIN = Check In, CHECKOUT = Check Out, CONNECT = Connect, COPY = Copy, DELETE = Delete, GET = Get, HEAD = Head, LABEL = Label, LINK = Link, LOCK = Lock, MERGE = Merge, MKACTIVITY = Make Activity, MKCALENDAR = Make Calendar, MKCOL = Make Collection, MKREDIRECTREF = Make Redirect Reference, MKWORKSPACE = Make Workspace, MOVE = Move, OPTIONS = Options, ORDERPATCH = Order Patch, PATCH = Patch, POST = Post, PRI = PRI, PROPFIND = Property Find, PROPPATCH = Property Patch, PUT = Put, QUERY = Query, REBIND = Rebind, REPORT = Report, SEARCH = Search, TRACE = Trace, UNBIND = Unbind, UNCHECKOUT = Un-Check Out, UNLINK = Unlink, UNLOCK = Unlock, UPDATE = Update, UPDATEREDIRECTREF = Update Redirect Reference, VERSION-CONTROL = Version Control

length.description: Request Length: The length of the entire HTTP request, in number of bytes. (optional)

referrer.description: HTTP Referrer: The request header that identifies the address of the previous web page, which is linked to the current web page or resource being requested. (optional)

uid.description: Unique ID: The unique identifier of the http request. (optional)

url.description: URL: The URL object that pertains to the request. (recommended)

user_agent.description: HTTP User-Agent: The request header that identifies the operating system and web browser. (recommended)

version.description: HTTP Version: The Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP) version. (recommended)

x_forwarded_for.description: X-Forwarded-For: The X-Forwarded-For header identifying the originating IP address(es) of a client connecting to a web server through an HTTP proxy or a load balancer. (optional)

object_http_response.description: The HTTP Response object contains detailed information about the response sent from a web server to the requester.

body_length.description: Response Body Length: The actual length of the HTTP response body, in number of bytes, independent of a potentially existing Content-Length header. (optional)

code.description: Response Code: The Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP) status code returned from the web server to the client. (required)

content_type.description: HTTP Content Type: The HTTP request header that identifies the original media type of the resource (prior to any content encoding applied for sending). (optional)

http_headers.description: HTTP Headers: Additional HTTP headers of an HTTP request or response. (recommended)

latency.description: Latency: The HTTP response latency measured in milliseconds. (optional)

length.description: Response Length: The length of the entire HTTP response, in number of bytes. (optional)

message.description: Message: The HTTP status code and reason phrase returned from the server. (optional)

status.description: Status: The response status. (optional)

object_iam_role.description: The IAM Role object describes permission characteristics (or privileges) associated with a user or group of users as security principals against one or more resources.

account.description: Account: The account associated with the role. (optional)

name.description: Name: The role name. (recommended)

policies.description: Policies: IAM policies associated with the role. (optional)

privileges.description: Privileges: List of privileges assigned to a role. (optional)

programmatic_credentials.description: Programmatic Credentials: Programmatic credential (API keys, access tokens, certificates, etc) associated with the role. (optional)

resources.description: Resources Array: Resources that the role applies to. (optional)

session.description: Session: The session where the role is active. (optional)

uid.description: Unique ID: The unique role identifier. (recommended)

uid_alt.description: Alternate ID: The alternate user identifier. (optional)

uid_numeric.description: Numeric Unique ID: The uid attribute in numeric form where applicable.Note: Producers may populate uid_numeric only in addition to uid and not as an alternative to it. (optional)

object_identity_activity_metrics.description: The Identity Activity Metrics object captures usage patterns, authentication activity, credential usage and other metrics for identities across cloud and on-premises environments.

first_seen_time.description: First Seen: The timestamp when this identity was first observed or created in the system. (optional)

first_seen_time_dt.description: First Seen: The timestamp when this identity was first observed or created in the system. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

last_authentication_time.description: Last Authentication Time: The timestamp when this identity last successfully authenticated to any system or service. (optional)

last_authentication_time_dt.description: Last Authentication Time: The timestamp when this identity last successfully authenticated to any system or service. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

last_seen_time.description: Last Seen: The timestamp of the most recent activity performed by this identity, including authentication, resource access, or API calls. (recommended)

last_seen_time_dt.description: Last Seen: The timestamp of the most recent activity performed by this identity, including authentication, resource access, or API calls. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

password_last_used_time.description: Password Last Used Time: The timestamp when password-based authentication was last used by this identity. (optional)

password_last_used_time_dt.description: Password Last Used Time: The timestamp when password-based authentication was last used by this identity. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

programmatic_credentials.description: Programmatic Credentials: Details about the programmatic credentials associated with this identity, such as API keys, service account keys, access tokens, and client certificates used for automated access. (optional)

object_idp.description: The Identity Provider object contains detailed information about a provider responsible for creating, maintaining, and managing identity information while offering authentication services to applications.

auth_factors.description: Authentication Factors: The Authentication Factors object describes the different types of Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) methods and/or devices supported by the Identity Provider. (optional)

domain.description: Domain: The primary domain associated with the Identity Provider. (optional)

fingerprint.description: Certificate Fingerprint: The fingerprint of the X.509 certificate used by the Identity Provider. (optional)

has_mfa.description: MFA Enforced: The Identity Provider enforces Multi Factor Authentication (MFA). (optional)

issuer.description: Issuer Details: The unique identifier (often a URL) used by the Identity Provider as its issuer. (optional)

name.description: Name: The name of the Identity Provider. (recommended)

protocol_name.description: Supported Protocol: The supported protocol of the Identity Provider. (optional)

scim.description: SCIM: The System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) resource object as defined in RFC 7634 provides a structured set of attributes related to SCIM protocols used for identity provisioning and management across cloud-based platforms. (optional)

sso.description: SSO: The Single Sign-On (SSO) object provides a structure for normalizing SSO attributes, configuration, and/or settings from Identity Providers. (optional)

state.description: State: The configuration state of the Identity Provider, normalized to the caption of the state_id value. (optional)

state_id.description: State ID: The normalized state ID of the Identity Provider to reflect its configuration or activation status. (optional) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Active, 2 = Suspended, 3 = Deprecated, 4 = Deleted, 99 = Other

tenant_uid.description: Tenant UID: The tenant ID associated with the Identity Provider. (optional)

uid.description: Unique ID: The unique identifier of the Identity Provider. (recommended)

uid_numeric.description: Numeric Unique ID: The uid attribute in numeric form where applicable.Note: Producers may populate uid_numeric only in addition to uid and not as an alternative to it. (optional)

url_string.description: Configuration URL: The URL for accessing the configuration or metadata of the Identity Provider. (optional)

object_image.description: The Image object provides a description of a specific Virtual Machine (VM) or Container image.

labels.description: Labels: The list of labels associated to the image. (optional)

name.description: Name: The image name. (recommended)

path.description: Path: The full path to the image file. (optional)

tags.description: Tags: The list of tags; {key:value} pairs associated to the image. (optional)

uid.description: Unique ID: The unique image ID. (required)

uid_numeric.description: Numeric Unique ID: The uid attribute in numeric form where applicable.Note: Producers may populate uid_numeric only in addition to uid and not as an alternative to it. (optional)

object_ja4_fingerprint.description: The JA4+ fingerprint object provides detailed fingerprint information about various aspects of network traffic which is both machine and human readable.

section_a.description: JA4 Section A: The 'a' section of the JA4 fingerprint. (optional)

section_b.description: JA4 Section B: The 'b' section of the JA4 fingerprint. (optional)

section_c.description: JA4 Section C: The 'c' section of the JA4 fingerprint. (optional)

section_d.description: JA4 Section D: The 'd' section of the JA4 fingerprint. (optional)

type.description: Type: The JA4+ fingerprint type as defined by FoxIO, normalized to the caption of 'type_id'. (optional)

type_id.description: Type ID: The identifier of the JA4+ fingerprint type. (required) 0 = Unknown, 1 = JA4, 2 = JA4Server, 3 = JA4HTTP, 4 = JA4Latency, 5 = JA4X509, 6 = JA4SSH, 7 = JA4TCP, 8 = JA4TCPServer, 9 = JA4TCPScan, 99 = Other

object_job.description: The Job object provides information about a scheduled job or task, including its name, command line, and state.

cmd_line.description: Command Line: The job command line. (recommended)

created_time.description: Created Time: The time when the job was created. (recommended)

created_time_dt.description: Created Time: The time when the job was created. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

desc.description: Description: The description of the job. (recommended)

file.description: File: The file that pertains to the job. (optional)

job_actions.description: Job Actions: An array of actions that will be performed by the job when certain conditions are met. (optional)

job_triggers.description: Job Triggers: An array of conditions or events that, when met, will initiate the job to perform specified actions. (optional)

last_run_time.description: Last Run: The time when the job was last run. (recommended)

last_run_time_dt.description: Last Run: The time when the job was last run. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

name.description: Name: The name of the job. (recommended)

next_run_time.description: Next Run: The time when the job will next be run. (optional)

next_run_time_dt.description: Next Run: The time when the job will next be run. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

run_state.description: Run State: The run state of the job. (optional)

run_state_id.description: Run State ID: The run state ID of the job. (recommended) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Ready, 2 = Queued, 3 = Running, 4 = Stopped, 5 = Disabled, 99 = Other

type.description: Type: The job type, normalized to the caption of the type_id value. (optional)

type_id.description: Type ID: The job type, i.e. (recommended) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Task Scheduler, 2 = Cron, 3 = Systemd, 4 = Launchd, 99 = Other

uid.description: Unique ID: The unique job identifier. (optional)

user.description: User: The user that created the job. (optional)

object_job_action.description: The action that will be performed by the job when certain conditions are met.

cmd_line.description: Command Line: When type_id is Execute (2), this describes the command line that is executed.When type_id is COM Handler (1), this may describe the DLL path stored in the COM component's InprocServer32 key or the command line stored in the COM component's (optional)

com_class_uuid.description: COM Class Identifier: When type_id is COM Handler (1), this describes the COM Class Identifier (CLSID). (optional)

file.description: File: When known, describes the image file that is executed when type_id is COM Handler or Execute. (optional)

properties.description: Properties: The list of properties associated with the performed action.Can be populated with additional attributes of a program execution process, COM object attributes, fields of a message box or an email. (recommended)

type.description: Type: The job action type, normalized to the caption of the type_id value. (recommended)

type_id.description: Type ID: The job action type. (required) 0 = Unknown, 1 = COM Handler, 2 = Execute, 3 = E-mail, 4 = Show Message, 99 = Other

working_directory.description: Working Directory: When type_id is Execute (2), this describes the working directory of a program that is run by the job. (optional)

object_job_trigger.description: The condition or event that, when met, will initiate the job to perform specified actions.

event_codes.description: Event Codes: Event identifiers that pertain to the job trigger. (optional)

last_run_time.description: Last Run: The time when the job was last run. (recommended)

last_run_time_dt.description: Last Run: The time when the job was last run. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

log_sources.description: Log Sources: A collection of log systems or components that pertain to the job trigger. (optional)

next_run_time.description: Next Run: The time when the job will next be run. (optional)

next_run_time_dt.description: Next Run: The time when the job will next be run. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

properties.description: Properties: The list of properties associated with the trigger.Can be used to describe time boundaries of the job, amount of repetitions or when the job should be activated or expired. (recommended)

type.description: Type: The job trigger type, normalized to the caption of the type_id value. (recommended)

type_id.description: Type ID: The job trigger type, i.e. (required) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Boot, 2 = Schedule, 3 = Event, 99 = Other

user.description: User: The user that pertains to the job trigger. (optional)

object_kb_article.description: The KB Article object contains metadata that describes the patch or update.

avg_timespan.description: Average Timespan: The average time to patch. (optional)

bulletin.description: Patch Bulletin: The kb article bulletin identifier. (optional)

classification.description: Classification: The vendors classification of the kb article. (optional)

created_time.description: Created Time: The date the kb article was released by the vendor. (optional)

created_time_dt.description: Created Time: The date the kb article was released by the vendor. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

install_state.description: Install State: The install state of the kb article. (recommended)

install_state_id.description: Install State ID: The normalized install state ID of the kb article. (recommended) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Installed, 2 = Not Installed, 3 = Installed Pending Reboot, 99 = Other

is_superseded.description: The patch is superseded.: The kb article has been replaced by another. (optional)

os.description: OS: The operating system the kb article applies. (recommended)

product.description: Product: The product details the kb article applies. (optional)

severity.description: Severity: The severity of the kb article. (recommended)

size.description: Size: The size in bytes for the kb article. (optional)

src_url.description: Source URL: The kb article link from the source vendor. (optional)

title.description: Title: The title of the kb article. (recommended)

uid.description: Unique ID: The unique identifier for the kb article. (recommended)

object_kernel.description: The Kernel Resource object provides information about a specific kernel resource, including its name and type.

is_system.description: System: The indication of whether the object is part of the operating system. (optional)

name.description: Name: The name of the kernel resource. (required)

path.description: Path: The full path of the kernel resource. (optional)

system_call.description: System Call: The system call that was invoked. (optional)

type.description: Type: The type of the kernel resource. (optional)

type_id.description: Type ID: The type of the kernel resource. (required) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Shared Mutex, 2 = System Call, 99 = Other

object_kernel_driver.description: The Kernel Extension object describes a kernel driver that has been loaded or unloaded into the operating system (OS) kernel.

file.description: File: The driver/extension file object. (required)

object_key_value_object.description: A generic object allowing to define a {key:value} pair.

name.description: Name: The name of the key. (required)

value.description: Value: The value associated to the key. (recommended)

values.description: Values: Optional, the values associated to the key. (recommended)

object_keyboard_info.description: The Keyboard Information object contains details and attributes related to a computer or device keyboard.

function_keys.description: Function Keys: The number of function keys on client keyboard. (optional)

ime.description: IME: The Input Method Editor (IME) file name. (optional)

keyboard_layout.description: Keyboard Layout: The keyboard locale identifier name (e.g., en-US). (optional)

keyboard_subtype.description: Keyboard Subtype: The keyboard numeric code. (optional)

keyboard_type.description: Keyboard Type: The keyboard type (e.g., xt, ico). (optional)

object_kill_chain_phase.description: The Kill Chain Phase object represents a single phase of a cyber attack, including the initial reconnaissance and planning stages up to the final objective of the attacker.

phase.description: Kill Chain Phase: The cyber kill chain phase. (recommended)

phase_id.description: Kill Chain Phase ID: The cyber kill chain phase identifier. (required) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Reconnaissance, 2 = Weaponization, 3 = Delivery, 4 = Exploitation, 5 = Installation, 6 = Command & Control, 7 = Actions on Objectives, 99 = Other

object_ldap_person.description: The additional LDAP attributes that describe a person.

cost_center.description: Cost Center: The cost center associated with the user. (optional)

created_time.description: Created Time: The timestamp when the user was created. (optional)

created_time_dt.description: Created Time: The timestamp when the user was created. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

deleted_time.description: Deleted Time: The timestamp when the user was deleted. (optional)

deleted_time_dt.description: Deleted Time: The timestamp when the user was deleted. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

department.description: Department: The name of the department in which the user works. (optional)

display_name.description: Display Name: The display name of the LDAP person. (optional)

email_addrs.description: Email Addresses: A list of additional email addresses for the user. (optional)

employee_uid.description: Employee ID: The employee identifier assigned to the user by the organization. (optional)

given_name.description: Given Name: The given or first name of the user. (optional)

hire_time.description: Hire Time: The timestamp when the user was or will be hired by the organization. (optional)

hire_time_dt.description: Hire Time: The timestamp when the user was or will be hired by the organization. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

job_title.description: Job Title: The user's job title. (optional)

labels.description: Labels: The labels associated with the user. (optional)

last_login_time.description: Last Login: The last time when the user logged in. (optional)

last_login_time_dt.description: Last Login: The last time when the user logged in. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

ldap_cn.description: LDAP Common Name: The LDAP and X.500 commonName attribute, typically the full name of the person. (optional)

ldap_dn.description: LDAP Distinguished Name: The X.500 Distinguished Name (DN) is a structured string that uniquely identifies an entry, such as a user, in an X.500 directory service For example, cn=John Doe,ou=People,dc=example,dc=com. (optional)

leave_time.description: Leave Time: The timestamp when the user left or will be leaving the organization. (optional)

leave_time_dt.description: Leave Time: The timestamp when the user left or will be leaving the organization. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

location.description: Geo Location: The geographical location associated with a user. (optional)

modified_time.description: Modified Time: The timestamp when the user entry was last modified. (optional)

modified_time_dt.description: Modified Time: The timestamp when the user entry was last modified. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

office_location.description: Office Location: The primary office location associated with the user. (optional)

phone_number.description: Telephone Number: The telephone number of the user. (optional)

surname.description: Surname: The last or family name for the user. (optional)

tags.description: Tags: The list of tags; {key:value} pairs associated to the user. (optional)

object_load_balancer.description: The load balancer object describes the load balancer entity and contains additional information regarding the distribution of traffic across a network.

classification.description: Classification: The request classification as defined by the load balancer. (optional)

code.description: Response Code: The numeric response status code detailing the connection from the load balancer to the destination target. (recommended)

dst_endpoint.description: Destination Endpoint: The destination to which the load balancer is distributing traffic. (recommended)

endpoint_connections.description: Endpoint Connections: An object detailing the load balancer connection attempts and responses. (recommended)

error_message.description: Error Message: The load balancer error message. (optional)

ip.description: IP Address: The IP address of the load balancer node that handled the client request. (optional)

message.description: Message: The load balancer message. (optional)

metrics.description: Metrics: General purpose metrics associated with the load balancer. (optional)

name.description: Name: The name of the load balancer. (recommended)

status_detail.description: Status Detail: The status detail contains additional status information about the load balancer distribution event. (optional)

uid.description: Unique ID: The unique identifier for the load balancer. (recommended)

uid_numeric.description: Numeric Unique ID: The uid attribute in numeric form where applicable.Note: Producers may populate uid_numeric only in addition to uid and not as an alternative to it. (optional)

object_location.description: The Geo Location object describes a geographical location, usually associated with an IP address.

aerial_height.description: Aerial Height: Expressed as either height above takeoff location or height above ground level (AGL) for a UAS current location. (optional)

city.description: City: The name of the city. (recommended)

continent.description: Continent: The name of the continent. (recommended)

coordinates.description: Coordinates: A two-element array, containing a longitude/latitude pair. (optional)

country.description: Country: The ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 country code.Note: The two letter country code should be capitalized. (recommended)

desc.description: Description: The description of the geographical location. (optional)

geodetic_altitude.description: Geodetic Altitude: The aircraft distance above or below the ellipsoid as measured along a line that passes through the aircraft and is normal to the surface of the WGS-84 ellipsoid. (optional)

geodetic_vertical_accuracy.description: Geodetic Vertical Accuracy: Provides quality/containment on geodetic altitude. (optional)

geohash.description: Geohash: Geohash of the geo-coordinates (latitude and longitude).Geohashing is a geocoding system used to encode geographic coordinates in decimal degrees, to a single string. (optional)

horizontal_accuracy.description: Horizontal Accuracy: Provides quality/containment on horizontal position. (optional)

is_on_premises.description: On-Premises: Indicates whether the location is on-premises. (optional)

isp.description: ISP Name: The name of the Internet Service Provider (ISP). (optional)

lat.description: Latitude: The geographical Latitude coordinate represented in Decimal Degrees (DD). (optional)

long.description: Longitude: The geographical Longitude coordinate represented in Decimal Degrees (DD). (optional)

postal_code.description: Postal Code: The postal code of the location. (optional)

pressure_altitude.description: Pressure Altitude: The uncorrected barometric pressure altitude (based on reference standard 29.92 inHg, 1013.25 mb) provides a reference for algorithms that utilize 'altitude deltas' between aircraft. (optional)

provider.description: Provider: The provider of the geographical location data. (optional)

region.description: Region: The alphanumeric code that identifies the principal subdivision (e.g. (optional)

object_logger.description: The Logger object represents the device and product where events are stored with times for receipt and transmission.

device.description: Device: The device where the events are logged. (recommended)

event_uid.description: Event UID: The unique identifier of the event assigned by the logger. (optional)

is_truncated.description: Is Truncated: Indicates whether the OCSF event data has been truncated due to size limitations. (optional)

log_format.description: Log Format: The format of data in the log. (optional)

log_level.description: Log Level: The level at which an event was logged. (optional)

log_name.description: Log Name: The log name for the logging provider log, or the file name of the system log. (recommended)

log_provider.description: Log Provider: The logging provider or logging service that logged the event. (recommended)

log_version.description: Log Version: The event log schema version of the original event. (optional)

logged_time.description: Logged Time: The time when this logger received and logged the event. (recommended)

logged_time_dt.description: Logged Time: The time when this logger received and logged the event. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

name.description: Name: The name of the logging product instance. (recommended)

product.description: Product: The product logging the event. (recommended)

transmit_time.description: Transmission Time: The time when the event was transmitted from the logging device to it's next destination. (recommended)

transmit_time_dt.description: Transmission Time: The time when the event was transmitted from the logging device to it's next destination. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

uid.description: Unique ID: The unique identifier of the logging product instance. (recommended)

uid_numeric.description: Numeric Unique ID: The uid attribute in numeric form where applicable.Note: Producers may populate uid_numeric only in addition to uid and not as an alternative to it. (optional)

untruncated_size.description: Untruncated Size: The original size of the OCSF event data in kilobytes before any truncation occurred. (optional)

version.description: Version: The version of the logging provider. (optional)

object_long_string.description: This object is a used to capture strings which may be truncated by a security product due to their length.

is_truncated.description: Is Truncated: Indicates that value has been truncated. (optional)

untruncated_size.description: Untruncated Size: The size in bytes of the string represented by value before truncation. (optional)

value.description: Value: The string value, truncated if is_truncated is true. (required)

object_malware.description: The Malware object describes the classification of known malicious software, which is intentionally designed to cause damage to a computer, server, client, or computer network.

classification_ids.description: Classification IDs: The list of normalized identifiers of the malware classifications. (required) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Adware, 10 = Ransomware, 11 = Remote-Access-Trojan, 13 = Resource-Exploitation, 14 = Rogue-Security-Software, 15 = Rootkit, 16 = Screen-Capture, 17 = Spyware, 18 = Trojan, 19 = Virus, 2 = Backdoor, 20 = Webshell, 21 = Wiper, 22 = Worm, 3 = Bot, 4 = Bootkit, 5 = DDOS, 6 = Downloader, 7 = Dropper, 8 = Exploit-Kit, 9 = Keylogger, 99 = Other

classifications.description: Classifications: The list of malware classifications, normalized to the captions of the classification_ids values. (optional)

cves.description: CVE List: The list of Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) identifiers associated with the malware. (optional)

files.description: Files: The list of file objects representing files that were identified as infected by the malware. (optional)

name.description: Name: The malware name, as reported by the detection engine. (recommended)

num_infected.description: Number of Infected Entities: The number of files that were identified to be infected by the malware. (optional)

path.description: Path: The filesystem path of the malware that was observed. (recommended)

provider.description: Provider: The name or identifier of the security solution or service that provided the malware detection information. (recommended)

severity.description: Severity: The severity of the malware, normalized to the captions of the severity_id values. (optional)

severity_id.description: Severity ID: The normalized identifier of the malware severity. (recommended) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Informational, 2 = Low, 3 = Medium, 4 = High, 5 = Critical, 6 = Fatal, 99 = Other

uid.description: Unique ID: A unique identifier for the specific malware instance, as assigned by the detection engine (e.g., virus signature ID or IPS rule ID). (recommended)

uid_numeric.description: Numeric Unique ID: The uid attribute in numeric form where applicable.Note: Producers may populate uid_numeric only in addition to uid and not as an alternative to it. (optional)

object_malware_scan_info.description: The malware scan information object describes characteristics, metadata of a malware scanning job.

end_time.description: End Time: The timestamp indicating when the scan job completed execution. (optional)

end_time_dt.description: End Time: The timestamp indicating when the scan job completed execution. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

name.description: Name: The administrator-supplied or application-generated name of the scan. (recommended)

num_files.description: Scanned Files: The total number of files analyzed during the scan. (optional)

num_infected.description: Number of Infected Entities: The total number of files identified as infected with malware during the scan. (optional)

num_volumes.description: Number of Volumes: The total number of storage volumes examined during the malware scan. (optional)

size.description: Size: The total size in bytes of all files that were scanned. (optional)

start_time.description: Start Time: The timestamp indicating when the scan job began execution. (optional)

start_time_dt.description: Start Time: The timestamp indicating when the scan job began execution. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

type.description: Type: The type of scan. (optional)

type_id.description: Type ID: The type id of the scan. (required) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Manual, 2 = Scheduled, 3 = Updated Content, 4 = Quarantined Items, 5 = Attached Media, 6 = User Logon, 7 = ELAM, 99 = Other

uid.description: Scan UID: The application-defined unique identifier assigned to an instance of a scan. (recommended)

uid_numeric.description: Numeric Unique ID: The uid attribute in numeric form where applicable.Note: Producers may populate uid_numeric only in addition to uid and not as an alternative to it. (optional)

unique_malware_count.description: Unique Malware Count: The number of unique malware detected across all infected files. (optional)

object_managed_entity.description: The Managed Entity object describes the type and version of an entity, such as a user, device, or policy.

data.description: Data: The managed entity content as a JSON object. (optional)

device.description: Device: An addressable device, computer system or host. (recommended)

expiration_time.description: Expiration Time: The expiration date of the indicator, after which it is no longer considered reliable. (optional)

expiration_time_dt.description: Expiration Time: The expiration date of the indicator, after which it is no longer considered reliable. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

external_uid.description: External ID: A unique identifier assigned by an external system for cross-referencing. (optional)

file.description: Related File: Any pertinent file information related to an indicator or OSINT analysis. (optional)

intrusion_sets.description: Intrusion Sets: A grouping of adversarial behaviors and resources believed to be associated with specific threat actors or campaigns. (optional)

labels.description: Labels: Tags or keywords associated with the indicator to enhance searchability. (optional)

location.description: Geo Location: Any pertinent geolocation information related to an indicator or OSINT analysis. (optional)

malware.description: Malware: A list of Malware objects, describing details about the identified malware. (optional)

modified_time.description: Modified Time: The timestamp of the last modification or update to the indicator. (optional)

modified_time_dt.description: Modified Time: The timestamp of the last modification or update to the indicator. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.
