references.description: References: Provides a reference to an external source of information related to the CTI being represented. (optional)

related_analytics.description: Related Analytics: Any analytics related to an indicator or OSINT analysis. (optional)

reputation.description: Reputation Scores: Related reputational analysis from third-party engines and analysts for a given indicator or OSINT analysis. (optional)

risk_score.description: Risk Score: A numerical representation of the threat indicator’s risk level. (optional)

script.description: Related Script Data: Any pertinent script information related to an indicator or OSINT analysis. (optional)

severity.description: Severity: Represents the severity level of the threat indicator, typically reflecting its potential impact or damage. (optional)

severity_id.description: Severity ID: The normalized severity level of the threat indicator, typically reflecting its potential impact or damage. (optional) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Informational, 2 = Low, 3 = Medium, 4 = High, 5 = Critical, 6 = Fatal, 99 = Other

signatures.description: Related Digital Signatures: Any digital signatures or hashes related to an indicator or OSINT analysis. (optional)

src_url.description: Source URL: The source URL of an indicator or OSINT analysis, e.g., a URL back to a TIP, report, or otherwise. (optional)

subdomains.description: Related Subdomains: Any pertinent subdomain information - such as those generated by a Domain Generation Algorithm - related to an indicator or OSINT analysis. (optional)

subnet.description: Related Subnet: A CIDR or network block related to an indicator or OSINT analysis. (optional)

threat_actor.description: Threat Actor: A threat actor is an individual or group that conducts malicious cyber activities, often with financial, political, or ideological motives. (optional)

tlp.description: Traffic Light Protocol: The Traffic Light Protocol (TLP) was created to facilitate greater sharing of potentially sensitive information and more effective collaboration. (recommended) AMBER = TLP:AMBER, AMBER STRICT = TLP:AMBER+STRICT, CLEAR = TLP:CLEAR, GREEN = TLP:GREEN, RED = TLP:RED, WHITE = TLP:WHITE

uploaded_time.description: Uploaded Time: The timestamp indicating when the associated indicator or intelligence was added to the system or repository. (optional)

uploaded_time_dt.description: Uploaded Time: The timestamp indicating when the associated indicator or intelligence was added to the system or repository. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

value.description: Indicator: The actual indicator value in scope, e.g., a SHA-256 hash hexdigest or a domain name. (required)

vendor_name.description: Vendor Name: The vendor name of a tool which generates intelligence or provides indicators. (optional)

vulnerabilities.description: Related Vulnerabilities: Any vulnerabilities related to an indicator or OSINT analysis. (optional)

whois.description: WHOIS: Any pertinent WHOIS information related to an indicator or OSINT analysis. (optional)

object_package.description: The Software Package object describes details about a software package.

architecture.description: Architecture: Architecture is a shorthand name describing the type of computer hardware the packaged software is meant to run on. (recommended)

cpe_name.description: The product CPE identifier: The Common Platform Enumeration (CPE) name. (optional)

hash.description: Hash: Cryptographic hash to identify the binary instance of a software component. (optional)

license.description: Software License: The software license applied to this package. (optional)

license_url.description: Software License URL: The URL pointing to the license applied on package or software. (optional)

name.description: Name: The software package name. (required)

package_manager.description: Package Manager: The software packager manager utilized to manage a package on a system, e.g. (optional)

package_manager_url.description: Package Manager URL: The URL of the package or library at the package manager, or the specific URL or URI of an internal package manager link such as AWS CodeArtifact or Artifactory. (optional)

purl.description: Package URL: A purl is a URL string used to identify and locate a software package in a mostly universal and uniform way across programming languages, package managers, packaging conventions, tools, APIs and databases. (optional)

release.description: Software Release Details: Release is the number of times a version of the software has been packaged. (optional)

src_url.description: Source URL: The link to the specific library or package such as within GitHub, this is different from the link to the package manager where the library or package is hosted. (optional)

type.description: Type: The type of software package, normalized to the caption of the type_id value. (optional)

type_id.description: Type ID: The type of software package. (recommended) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Application, 2 = Operating System, 99 = Other

uid.description: Package UID: A unique identifier for the package or library reported by the source tool. (optional)

vendor_name.description: Vendor Name: The name of the vendor who published the software package. (optional)

version.description: Version: The software package version. (required)

object_packet.description: The Packet object represents a single captured network packet and its associated metadata.

encoding.description: Encoding: The human-readable name of the encoding used to represent the packet data in the value field. (optional)

encoding_id.description: Encoding ID: The normalized identifier of the encoding method used to represent the packet data as a string. (recommended) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Base64, 2 = Hexadecimal, 3 = URL Encoded, 99 = Other

end_offset.description: End Offset: The ending byte position of this packet within a capture file or stream. (optional)

format.description: Format: The human-readable name of the packet capture file format in which the packet is stored. (optional)

format_id.description: Format ID: The normalized identifier of the packet capture format. (recommended) 0 = Unknown, 1 = PCAP, 2 = PCAPNG, 3 = Snoop, 4 = ERF, 5 = NetMon, 6 = 5Views, 99 = Other

source.description: Source: The human-readable name describing how or where the packet was obtained. (optional)

source_id.description: Source ID: A normalized numeric identifier that specifies how the packet was obtained or generated. (recommended) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Wire, 2 = Stream, 3 = Decoder, 4 = TAP, 5 = SPAN, 6 = Endpoint, 7 = Virtual, 99 = Other

start_offset.description: Start Offset: The starting byte position of this packet within a capture file or stream. (optional)

value.description: Value: The actual packet data, represented as a string. (required)

object_parameter.description: The Parameter object provides details regarding a parameter of a a function.

name.description: Name: The parameter name. (optional)

post_value.description: Post-Value: The parameter value after function execution. (optional)

pre_value.description: Pre-Value: The parameter value before function execution. (optional)

object_peripheral_device.description: The peripheral device object describes the properties of external, connectable, and detachable hardware.

class.description: Class: The class of the peripheral device. (optional)

name.description: Name: The name of the peripheral device. (required)

serial_number.description: Serial Number: The peripheral device serial number. (recommended)

type.description: Peripheral Device Type: The Peripheral Device type, normalized to the caption of the type_id value. (optional)

type_id.description: Peripheral Device Type ID: The normalized peripheral device type ID. (recommended) 0 = Unknown, 1 = External Storage, 2 = Keyboard, 3 = Mouse, 4 = Printer, 5 = Monitor, 6 = Microphone, 7 = Webcam, 99 = Other

uid.description: Unique ID: The unique identifier of the peripheral device. (recommended)

uid_numeric.description: Numeric Unique ID: The uid attribute in numeric form where applicable.Note: Producers may populate uid_numeric only in addition to uid and not as an alternative to it. (optional)

vendor_id_list.description: Vendor ID List: The list of vendor IDs for the peripheral device. (recommended)

vendor_name.description: Vendor Name: The primary vendor name for the peripheral device. (recommended)

object_permission_analysis_result.description: The Permission Analysis object describes analysis results of permissions, policies directly associated with an identity (user, role, or service account).

analyzed_privileges_count.description: Analyzed Privileges Count: The total count of privileges that were analyzed across all services. (optional)

condition_keys.description: Condition Keys: The condition keys and their values that were evaluated during policy analysis, including contextual constraints that affect permission grants. (optional)

granted_privileges.description: Granted Privileges: The specific privileges, actions, or permissions that are explicitly granted by the analyzed policy. (optional)

policy.description: Policy: Detailed information about the policy document that was analyzed, including policy metadata, version, type (identity-based, resource-based, etc.), and structural details. (recommended)

service_privilege_analysis_list.description: Service Privilege Analysis List: The list of privilege analysis results grouped by cloud service or namespace. (optional)

total_potential_attacks_count.description: Total Potential Attacks Count: The total count of privilege-to-attack technique mappings identified across all analyzed privileges. (optional)

unused_privileges_count.description: Unused Privileges Count: The total count of privileges or actions defined in the policy that have not been utilized within the analysis timeframe. (optional)

unused_services_count.description: Unused Services Count: The total count of cloud services or resource types referenced in the policy that have not been accessed or utilized within the analysis timeframe. (optional)

object_policy.description: The Policy object describes the policies that are applicable.

data.description: Data: Additional data about the policy such as the underlying JSON policy itself or other details. (optional)

desc.description: Description: The description of the policy. (optional)

is_applied.description: Applied: A determination if the content of a policy was applied to a target or request, or not. (recommended)

name.description: Name: The policy name. (recommended)

type.description: Type: The policy type. (optional)

uid.description: Unique ID: A unique identifier of the policy instance. (recommended)

version.description: Version: The policy version number. (recommended)

object_port_info.description: The Port Information object describes a port and its associated protocol details.

protocol_name.description: Protocol Name: The IP protocol name in lowercase, as defined by the Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA). (recommended)

protocol_num.description: Protocol Number: The IP protocol number, as defined by the Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA). (optional)

object_prev_event.description: The Previous Event object references the previous event in a chain of events.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint: The fingerprint of the previous event, binding this reference to the previous event's content so that altering or substituting the previous event breaks the link. (optional)

type_uid.description: Type ID: The event type identifier of the previous event, as carried in that event's type_uid. (recommended)

uid.description: Unique ID: The unique identifier of the previous event, as carried in that event's metadata.uid. (required)

object_privilege_attack_info.description: The Privilege Attack Info object groups privileges by the potential attack they could enable.

attack.description: MITRE ATT&CK® Details: The MITRE ATT&CK technique that these privileges could enable. (required)

privilege_info_list.description: Privilege Info List: The list of privilege information objects, where each element describes a specific privilege that could enable the associated attack technique. (required)

object_privilege_info.description: The Privilege Info object describes information about a specific privilege, action, or permission.

is_unused.description: Is Unused: Indicates whether the privilege is unused within the analysis timeframe. (optional)

last_used_time.description: Last Used Time: The most recent time this privilege was used. (optional)

last_used_time_dt.description: Last Used Time: The most recent time this privilege was used. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

name.description: Name: The name of the privilege, action, or permission. (required)

type.description: Type: The type or category of the privilege, normalized to the caption of the type_id value. (optional)

type_id.description: Type ID: The normalized type of the privilege. (optional) 0 = Unknown, 1 = Read, 2 = Write, 3 = Execute, 99 = Other

container.description: Container: The information describing an instance of a container. (recommended) Needs profile: container.

environment_variables.description: Environment Variables: Environment variables associated with the process. (optional)

file.description: File: The process file object. (recommended)

created_time_dt.description: Created Time: The time when the related event/finding was created. (optional) Needs profile: datetime.

status.description: Status: The related event status. (optional)

title.description: Title: A title or a brief phrase summarizing the related event/finding. (optional)
